findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “I didn’t break through my chains that night.”
findings.source_quote: “We came out of the prayer rooms, and someone was being sung for.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «alguien estaba recibiendo una canción» with «estaban cantando por alguien» to convey that someone was being sung for.
findings.translation_quote: «Salimos de las salas de oración y alguien estaba recibiendo una canción».

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “I didn’t break through my chains that night.”
findings.source_quote: “I found my counselors the next afternoon, and we prayed through together.”
